description: Fork of exp428 (NAP=6 everywhere, bs=16, 1.4983). HARD forward (argmax pick, unchanged) but SOFT weight gradient: weight grad attributed across all 2^NAP rows via sel_soft instead of index_add at chosen row only (enable_soft_weight_grad). Decomposes the exp444 soft-forward win (1.4821): if this matches exp444 the gain is purely dense weight-grad (keeps cheap hard inference); if it matches exp428 the gain needs the soft forward. Same mechanism as tiny-scale exp360 (which mildly regressed) but on the exp428/exp444 base. soft_weight_grad=true added.
